gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-inscriptiona: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps its small counters unclogged and friendly. Bellota's wire-thin look and far-flung s give the pair its strongest quality: a commanding headline sitting over a body that stays easy to see into.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Noto Sans Javanese reads clean and neutral, its apertures keeping every counter linked to the space outside. Bellota does the loud work, with a single-line stroke like cut vinyl, while the sans simply gets on with being legible.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Bellota's whole word looks bent from a single piece of wire, with the s ends hanging far from its spine. And Noto Sans Kawi sits beneath it, tidy and neutral, with an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Bellota looks sketched with a pencil that never presses harder, its s ends hanging well clear of the spine. Noto Sans Linear A keeps its gaping c wide open.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Noto Sans Linear B moves smoothly around every bend. Over a longer passage it would feel modern and unhurried, with Bellota's matched arches on r, n and m giving the headline above it a sturdy, distinctive stance.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Distinctive is the first word for Bellota, a bent paperclip of a typeface with no thick-thin shifts, best large and short. Noto Sans Manichaean follows with open-mouthed e crossbars and a clean, modern finish.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Bellota draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, with the s ends dangling far from the spine. But Noto Sans Mongolian feels quietly modern beside it, flaring its terminals outward while the heading stays sparse and stubbornly even.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lue: Commanding, in a monoline way, is how Bellota greets you. Noto Sans New Tai Lue would carry a longer passage smoothly, its round letters cupped rather than clenched.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-nko: Bellota never swells or thins a stroke, and its s ends hang far from the spine. But Noto Sans NKo is the see-through half of the pair, with c openings you can look straight through.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoined: Lines like bent rope or tubing define Bellota, with its far-hanging s. Noto Sans NKo Unjoined then settles underneath, giving small letters wide openings, so the heading plays loud and the body plays friendly.
